standardPresetDescription: A balanced classroom lesson with introduction, teaching, guided/independent practice, assessment, and closure.
guideHelp: Four providers, same path: create an account, add billing, then create an API key. Follow the red arrow on each diagram.
guideScreenshotPending: Real console screenshot coming soon — follow the official link for now.
guideKeyWarning: Providers show the full secret only once. Copy it into a password manager before you close the dialog — you cannot retrieve it later.
guideNoStore: LessonPrep has no database of keys. We only keep an encrypted token in this browser and never show the secret again. If you lose the key, create a new one at the provider.
guideFromSettings: Need a key? Open the step-by-step guide
guideOpenAiAccount: Open the OpenAI Platform (not ChatGPT). Sign up or log in — ChatGPT Plus does not include API access.
guideOpenAiBilling: Open Billing, add a payment method, and load prepaid credits. An empty balance returns quota errors even with a valid key.
guideOpenAiKey: Open API keys → Create new secret key. Name it, copy it immediately, then paste it in LessonPrep Settings.
guideGeminiAccount: Open Google AI Studio and sign in with Google. New users get a default Cloud project after accepting the terms.
guideGeminiBilling: On the API keys page, choose Set up billing for your project, link a Cloud Billing account, and add the required prepaid credits.
guideGeminiKey: On API keys, create a key for your project. Copy it once, then paste it in LessonPrep Settings under Gemini.
guideAnthropicAccount: Open the Anthropic Console (not claude.ai chat). Sign up or log in — a Claude Pro seat does not include API credits.
guideAnthropicBilling: Open Plans & Billing, add a payment method, and buy prepaid credits before you rely on the key.
guideAnthropicKey: Open Settings → API keys → Create key. Copy the sk-ant-… secret once, then paste it in LessonPrep Settings.
guideDeepSeekAccount: Open the DeepSeek API platform and register with email or phone. This is separate from the free DeepSeek chat app.
guideDeepSeekBilling: Open Top up / Billing and add credits. Usage is pay-as-you-go; an empty balance blocks API calls.
guideDeepSeekKey: Open API Keys → Create new key. Copy the secret immediately, then paste it in LessonPrep Settings under DeepSeek.
